nombre: Infografía de mecanismo: ingredientes hacia órganos
descripcion: Infografía de mecanismo sobre un fondo de naturaleza con bokeh y luz cálida, hojas nítidas que enmarcan las esquinas y una mesa de madera en la mitad inferior. Arriba, un titular centrado de 2 líneas en mayúsculas verde oscuro y un subtítulo de una línea. El producto va centrado sobre la mesa; a su izquierda, un bloque que nombra el mecanismo de doble acción (etiqueta dorada, 2 líneas y un subrayado fino) y a su derecha, 3 insignias apiladas (ícono en un círculo blanco y texto corto). Bajo el producto hay un diagrama: dos zonas del cuerpo ilustradas, cada una con su pastilla de acción, y una fila de 5 círculos de ingredientes cuyas flechas curvas suben hacia ellas. Abajo cierra una banda-pastilla ancha con un check y la garantía.
reference_style: Natural, warm, trustworthy supplement-style infographic: the product on a wooden table in a sunlit bokeh garden, a dual-action mechanism diagram where ingredient circles send curved arrows up to two illustrated target zones, side badges and a cream-gold guarantee pill

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two-line headline. 2) The product centered on the table. 3) The mechanism diagram: the two illustrated target zones with their action pills and the row of ingredient circles with arrows. 4) The dual-system text on the left and the three badges on the right. 5) The subtitle. 6) The guarantee pill at the bottom.
art_direction.composition_style: Centered, symmetrical, top-to-bottom flow: headline → product flanked by two side text columns → two target zones → ingredients → guarantee. The diagram reads bottom-up (ingredients feed the target zones) and sits directly under the product so the product visually contains the mechanism. Foreground leaves frame the four corners.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline from about 6% to 18% of the canvas height and subtitle at about 19.5-23%, both centered, up to about 70% of the width. Product centered at 50% of the width, from about 25% to 64% of the height (about 39% of the canvas height and 24% of the width), base on the table. Left block: about 7-36% of the width and 39-51% of the height (label, 2 lines and a thin underline ending in a small dot). Right badges: three rows at about 68-96% of the width, at about 34-41%, 42-48% and 49-56% of the height; icon circle about 7% of the canvas in diameter on the left of each row, text to its right. Target zones: two illustrations about 13-15% of the canvas wide, at about 34-48% and 54-66% of the width, from about 57% to 71% of the height, overlapping the bottom of the product. Action pills: about 22-33% of the width (left) and 66-79% (right), at about 62-66% of the height, just outside each target zone. Arrows between about 69% and 76% of the height. Ingredient circles: five, about 9.5% of the canvas in diameter, evenly spaced from about 23% to 77% of the width, at about 76-85% of the height. Guarantee pill: about 16-84% of the width and 87-97% of the height. Foreground leaves in the four corners, each about 12-16% of the canvas.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm golden sunlight from the top center, soft bokeh of green foliage in the background, a faint pattern of thin molecular hexagon lines over the background, and crisp foreground leaves in the corners for depth. The table is a light wooden surface in perspective. The product has soft warm light and a gentle contact shadow on the wood. Target zones are glossy semi-realistic 3D illustrations; one may carry a small action effect such as a flame. Ingredient circles are white with a soft drop shadow. The guarantee pill has a soft shadow and a subtle metallic gold border.

layout_summary: Square canvas: sunlit nature bokeh in the upper half, a light wooden table in perspective in the lower half, green leaves framing the four corners. A 2-line dark green uppercase headline and a 1-line subtitle centered at the top. The user's product stands centered on the table. To its left, a dual-action mechanism text block (gold label, 2 white lines and a thin gold underline ending in a dot); to its right, three stacked badges (white circle with a dark line icon and 2 short white uppercase lines). Just below the product, two illustrated target zones side by side, each with a dark rounded action pill on its outer side. Under them, a row of five white circles with ingredient illustrations, each sending a thin curved dark-green arrow up to the zone it acts on. At the bottom, a wide cream-gold rounded pill with a check icon and a 2-line guarantee.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full canvas; table from about 59% of the height to the bottom
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Natural, trustworthy setting that frames the product as clean and natural
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Sunlit outdoor bokeh of green foliage with warm golden light in the upper half, a faint thin-line molecular hexagon pattern over it, and a light wooden table in perspective filling the lower ~40% of the canvas. Adjust the greenery tone to the palette while keeping it natural.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Four corners, each about 12-16% of the canvas, partly cut by the edges
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Foreground framing that adds depth and reinforces the natural feel
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Sharp green leaves (or the plant that matches the main ingredient) entering from each corner, never covering text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center, 50% of the width, from about 25% to 64% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Main visual anchor; the source of the mechanism
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front view, standing on the table with a soft contact shadow; its lower part may be slightly covered by the target-zone illustrations.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left of the product, about 7-36% of the width and 39-51% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the two-way mechanism at a glance
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: A gold label line, two short white lines below it, and a thin gold underline ending in a small dot that points toward the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right of the product, about 68-96% of the width, rows at about 34-41%, 42-48% and 49-56% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Proof and reassurance points (scientific backing, safety, what it does not contain)
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: White circles about 7% of the canvas in diameter with a dark green line icon that literally represents each point (flask, organ, crossed-out ingredient, shield, leaf...), each followed by two short white uppercase lines. Write adapted reassurance content for the user's product: scientific backing, protection of a sensitive area, and the absence of an unwanted ingredient or side effect.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Below the product, at about 34-48% and 54-66% of the width, from about 57% to 71% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows where and how the product acts
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Two glossy semi-realistic 3D illustrations of the two zones the product acts on: organs for a supplement, skin or hair layers for a cosmetic, surfaces or materials for a home product. Each may carry a small effect that shows its action (flame, shield, glow, droplets).

detected_visual_blocks.position: Outer side of each target zone: about 22-33% of the width (left) and 66-79% (right), at about 62-66% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the action on each zone in one word
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Dark olive or dark brand-color rounded pills with white text, touching or nearly touching their zone.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Row at about 76-85% of the height, evenly spaced from about 23% to 77% of the width, each about 9.5% of the canvas in diameter
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows what the product is made of
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: White circles with a soft shadow, each holding a realistic illustration of one of the user's real key ingredients or components. If the product has fewer than five, use three or four and keep the row centered.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Between the ingredient row and the target zones, about 69-76% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Turns the infographic into a mechanism: which ingredient acts on which zone
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Thin curved dark-green arrows, one from the top of each circle up to the zone it acts on, curving gently inward; the left ingredients feed the left zone and the right ones the right zone.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom center, about 16-84% of the width and 87-97% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Removes the risk at the end of the reading
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Wide fully rounded pill in a cream-to-gold gradient with a thin gold border and a soft shadow; a dark check-in-circle icon on its left and two lines of text. Write the guarantee adapted to the user's product.

text_layers.reference_position: Top center, about 6-18% of the canvas height
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, uppercase, each line about 6.5% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, centered, dark forest green (or the darkest brand color) over the light bokeh
text_layers.guia_texto: La promesa principal ligada a la zona que el producto protege o mejora, con tono natural. De 5 a 8 palabras.

text_layers.text_style: Medium sans-serif, uppercase, about 3.8% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, near-black or dark green
text_layers.guia_texto: El beneficio sin sacrificio o lo que evita (por ejemplo «sin dietas extremas» o «vuelve a sentirte ligero»). De 4 a 7 palabras.

text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, about 3.5% of the canvas height, 1 line, left-aligned, gold
text_layers.guia_texto: El nombre del mecanismo terminado en dos puntos (por ejemplo «Doble acción:»). 2 o 3 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Left block, under the label, above the gold underline
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, about 3% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, white
text_layers.guia_texto: Las dos acciones del mecanismo unidas por «&» o «y». De 4 a 6 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Right column, first row, right of the icon circle
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, about 2.6-2.8% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, white
text_layers.guia_texto: El respaldo de la fórmula (ciencia, estudios, ingredientes probados). De 2 a 3 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Right column, second row, right of the icon circle
text_layers.guia_texto: Una protección o beneficio extra sobre una zona sensible. De 2 a 3 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Right column, third row, right of the icon circle
text_layers.guia_texto: Lo que el producto NO contiene o el efecto indeseado que evita («Sin…»). De 3 a 5 palabras.

text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, about 2.8% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, white
text_layers.guia_texto: Un verbo de acción sobre la zona izquierda (por ejemplo «Limpia»). 1 palabra.

text_layers.text_style: Same style as the left action pill
text_layers.guia_texto: Un verbo de acción sobre la zona derecha, distinto del izquierdo (por ejemplo «Protege»). 1 palabra.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the guarantee pill, right of the check icon
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, uppercase, about 3.3% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, near-black
text_layers.guia_texto: La promesa sin riesgo con el plazo de resultados y la devolución (por ejemplo «garantía de satisfacción…»). De 8 a 14 palabras.

mandatory_visual_elements: Sunlit nature bokeh background with a wooden table in the lower half and leaves framing the corners
Two-line dark green headline and one-line subtitle at the top
The user's product centered on the table
Dual-mechanism text block on the left and three icon badges on the right
Two illustrated target zones under the product, each with a dark action pill
Row of five ingredient circles with curved arrows up to the target zones
Wide cream-gold guarantee pill with a check icon at the bottom
forbidden_additions: Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
notas_paleta: Paleta natural y cálida: verdes del follaje, madera clara y luz dorada. Titular en verde bosque oscuro (o el color más oscuro de la marca); etiqueta del mecanismo y bordes en dorado; textos laterales en blanco; pastillas de acción en verde oliva oscuro; banda de garantía en crema con degradado dorado. Los colores de marca aparecen en el producto y pueden teñir sutilmente las pastillas y los íconos.
